name: femto.style
description: The femto documentation site: plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, built by build.mjs
author: Leo Herzog

scripts.dev: node build.mjs && { node --watch-path=site --watch-path=build.mjs --watch-path=markdown.mjs build.mjs & B=$!; wrangler pages dev dist --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8723 --show-interactive-dev-session=false & S=$!; trap 'kill $B $S 2>/dev/null' EXIT INT TERM; wait; }
